home.metaTitle: Search your AI chat history privately | LLMnesia
home.metaDescription: Find old prompts and answers across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and more with LLMnesia, the free Chrome and Edge extension. German introduction and installation guide; app interface currently in English.
home.eyebrow: Free for Chrome and Edge. Your search stays on your device.
home.title: Find the answer you already had.
home.intro: Your best answers are scattered across AI chats. LLMnesia brings your supported chat history into one searchable archive on your device, so you can find an old prompt, idea or decision again.
home.guide: Install and run your first search
home.languageNotice: This introduction and installation guide are in German. The extension, Vault web app and payment pages currently use English. Your conversations keep their original language.
home.localNote: No account is needed for free local search. Vault is an optional paid service.
home.exampleLabel: An example of finding an old conversation
home.exampleTitle: Kyoto itinerary: five days with a trip to Nara
home.exampleSnippet: You already planned this trip. Find the saved conversation and continue from the exact message.
home.exampleCaption: Illustration of the workflow; the app interface is currently in English.
home.featuresKicker: One archive for your AI work
home.featureSearchBody: Search your indexed conversations across supported AI tools from one place. Filter by assistant or date and open the matching message.
home.featureImportBody: Import older conversations from supported platforms. After installation, supported new conversations are captured as you work.
home.featureArchiveBody: Read saved conversations offline, export your archive, and keep a copy even if the original conversation is deleted later. Chats that were never saved cannot be recovered.
home.platformsTitle: Works with the AI tools you use
home.platformsLocal: Local Claude Code, Codex and ZCode sessions can also be indexed with the optional local setup.
home.stepInstallBody: Add LLMnesia from the Chrome Web Store or Microsoft Edge Add-ons. Use a desktop browser for installation.
home.stepImportBody: Open LLMnesia and import conversations from your supported AI accounts. Let the import finish before searching older chats.
home.stepSearchBody: Press Cmd + Shift + 9 on macOS or Ctrl + Shift + 9 on Windows and Linux. Start with a distinctive word or phrase from a saved conversation.
home.privacyLocalBody: Your saved chat content and search index stay in your browser on this device. No account or cloud sync is required for local search.
home.privacyVaultBody: Vault adds paid end-to-end encrypted backup and sync. If you enable it, your archive is encrypted on your device before upload. We cannot read that encrypted archive.
home.privacyAnalytics: LLMnesia uses limited product analytics to understand feature usage and errors. Conversation content and search queries are not included. Read the English privacy policy for full details.
home.faqLanguageQuestion: Is the whole app available in German?
home.faqLanguageAnswer: Not yet. This page and the installation guide are in German. The extension interface, Vault, payment pages and wider documentation currently use English. We are testing this introduction before extending translation to more of the product.
home.faqSearchQuestion: Can I use it with German conversations?
home.faqSearchAnswer: Your conversations are saved in their original language. Search quality depends on the wording and the search method. We do not currently promise reliable German semantic search or translation between languages. Start with distinctive terms that appear in the saved chat.
home.faqFreeAnswer: Local chat capture, supported imports and local search are free. Vault is an optional paid service for encrypted backup, sync and its web app.
home.faqDeletedQuestion: Can it recover a chat that was already deleted?
home.faqDeletedAnswer: Only if LLMnesia saved that conversation before it was deleted. It cannot restore content that was never captured or imported.
home.closingTitle: Make your next useful answer easier to find.
home.closingBody: Install LLMnesia and bring your supported chat history into one local archive.
guide.metaTitle: Install LLMnesia and search your AI history | German guide
guide.metaDescription: A German guide to installing LLMnesia in Chrome or Edge, importing your AI chat history and running your first search. App controls currently use English.
guide.title: From installation to your first search.
guide.intro: Use a desktop version of Chrome or Microsoft Edge. The steps below are explained in German; the extension controls currently use English.
guide.installBody: Open the listing for your browser, select its installation button and review the requested permissions. Then open LLMnesia from the browser's extensions menu. Pin it to the toolbar if you want quick access.
guide.importBody: Sign in to your own account on a supported AI platform. Open LLMnesia and use that platform's history-import option where available. Keep the required tab open while the import runs and wait for completion. Other supported conversations are indexed as you open them.
guide.importCaution: An import can only capture content your account can still access. It cannot retrieve a conversation that was deleted before LLMnesia saved it.
guide.searchBody: Press Cmd + Shift + 9 on macOS or Ctrl + Shift + 9 on Windows and Linux to open search. Enter a distinctive term from a conversation you just imported. Open a result to jump to the matching message.
guide.searchExample: Try a project name, an unusual phrase, or a place name that appears in a saved chat.
guide.shortcutNote: If the shortcut is unavailable, open search from the extension toolbar button and check your browser's extension-shortcut settings.
guide.troubleshootBody: Check that the import finished, that the conversation was captured, and that no assistant or date filter is hiding it. Try a shorter term copied from the original chat. German semantic and cross-language search are not guaranteed.
guide.privacyBody: Free local search keeps your saved conversations and index in this browser on this device. Vault is optional and paid; enabling it adds end-to-end encrypted backup and sync. Keep your own exports if you want an additional backup.
guide.nextBody: LLMnesia indexes supported new conversations as you work. Search again when you want to find a previous answer, prompt or decision.
listing.name: LLMnesia — Search your AI chat history
listing.summary: Search saved AI chats locally. Free. German guide; app interface in English.
listing.description:
Find answers you already had. LLMnesia searches your saved AI chat history across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Kimi, Qwen and other supported tools.

Import your existing history, search indexed conversations, filter results and open the matching message. Saved copies can be read offline and exported. Conversations deleted before LLMnesia saved them cannot be recovered.

Free local search keeps your conversation content and search index in your browser on this device. No account is required. Optional paid Vault adds end-to-end encrypted backup, sync and a web app. Limited product analytics do not include conversation content or search queries.

Language: German introduction and installation guide are available at https://www.llmnesia.com/de. The extension interface, Vault and payment pages currently use English. Conversations keep their original language. Reliable German semantic search and cross-language search are not currently guaranteed.

Install in desktop Chrome or Microsoft Edge, import your supported history and start with a distinctive term from a saved conversation.
